reviews.title: Flawless Execution
reviews.text:
It’s 2018 and 07’scape is still one of the greatest MMO’s of all time. The fact that it’s held up throughout the years is incredible. Most games of this genre don’t last nearly as long, and when they do, they’re oversaturated and don’t appeal to their playerbase. It’s mind-blowing to think that I played this game as a child and still enjoy it 12 years later.

 Jagex does everything they can to listen to their players, and they never implement major changes without player approval. They do this by implementing a polling system in which each player has the opportunity to vote on ideas they would or would not like to be in the game. And changes are only made if 75% of players approve.

Definitely worth a download if you’re feeling nostalgic or if you want to sink your teeth in to a classic MMO. No one’s done it quite like this- and they most likely never will.

reviews.title: Classic feel & Well optimized*

When I was a kid growing up in the early 2000s I would religiously play this game when the parents let me on the computer. It was a new experience for me that opened many personal relationships across the world. For those gamers who only experienced games like Fortnite and more modern games , OSRS might feel archaic.

reviews.title: Exactly what you expect from OSRS, well-optimized for mobile.

If you’ve never played before, just take your time. This game is all about the journey. It’s worth it. It’s a great, chill game to pass the time, get invested in your character, have the freedom to do whatever you want to do, and hang out with a pretty social playerbase.

reviews.title: Server crash FIX
reviews.text:
For everyone looking at the reviews trying to figure out how to fix the connectivity issues look no further!

What you want to do is make sure you have OSRS closed out from your app multitasks (when you double click the home button/swipe up to see open applications) go to the OSRS website and right below where it says “Free Player? Play Now!” Click “manually select world” and then manually select a world. You’ll get a prompt asking to open in the OSRS app and you hit open. There you go!! Now go have fun! The grind is real! Now not all worlds work for some reason, but personally world 332 or 32 works perfect for me and lets me log in every time. You’ll need to try out every world to see which ones work for you.

Although there are some minor complications, it is expected because there is a lack of a mouse and “clicking” takes time to get used to. Combat and questing is hard due to the core mechanics of the app, but I would recommend this to skill/afk train. Overall, the RuneScape app delivers a lot. I have only used it on mobile, however, I think the “quality of life” issues previously mentioned would be mostly eliminated on a tablet with a stylus.

reviews.title: Good game, now on iOS, could use very minor UI work
reviews.text:
OSRS is a MMORPG, but it handles character progression differently than any other MMO I’ve seen. I feel it has far better character customization when it comes to skills and builds.

As for it on iOS, it’s decent, but could be better optimized with the UI on some devices. With the iPhone SE, the top-left chat bars are hard to touch, which I believe can be solved by moving the bar down a tiny bit so it isn’t on the screen edge. With an iPad, the textures seem upscaled slightly (appears more jagged), and the bank interface overlaps the inventory screen (overall minor QA should have caught that). But on both devices, the game is still very much playable.

To me, this is the best MMO available for mobile, and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to others, old and new players alike!

reviews.title: Fighting Ice and Moss Giants
reviews.text: Okay - I’m level 86, (68-70 attack,strength,defense) which is consider a higher level. Ice Giants, Warriors and Moss Giants are level 42-52. I wear full Rune armor and used both a rune scimmy and rune battle axe and wear an amulet of power. I killed about 20 just now in the ice cave. In order for me to kill that many I needed 1 sword fish, 3 lobsters and a bagget to stay healthy and not die. I had 69 hit points to start. It seems to me that any enemy 30 to 40 levels below me with no armor would have a hard time chasing me away. It doesnt make any sense? In addition the rewards or “drops” are pathetic. It is NOT worth fighting these characters and lower levels should stay away altogether you wont be there long anyway.
